scenes.title: A diligence packet that shows its work.
scenes.body: Deterministic checks support human review. They do not make investment decisions.
scenes.proof: Synthetic case  /  offline execution  /  explicit limitations
scenes.caption: This system checks evidence for diligence. It does not make the investment decision.

scenes.title: Unsupported material claims stop the workflow.
scenes.body: The candidate memo starts with a $4.8 million contracted ARR claim but supplies no retained evidence.
scenes.caption: The candidate memo starts with an unsupported claim: VectorForge has 4.8 million dollars of contracted ARR.

scenes.title: Failure is a result—not an exception.
scenes.body: The receipt preserves the failing state, limitations, source inventory, and content digest for review.
scenes.proof: UNVERIFIED is explicit. HOLD is deterministic.
scenes.caption: The local gate returns unverified, and the workflow stays on hold. That failure is retained in the receipt.

scenes.title: Evidence can support, contradict, or be blocked.
scenes.body: Add frozen source snapshots, exact spans, source dates, calculations, and counterevidence—without erasing disagreement.
scenes.caption: Now add retained synthetic source snapshots, exact evidence spans, source dates, calculations, and counterevidence.

scenes.title: The same inputs produce the same packet.
scenes.body: Canonical JSON, Decimal arithmetic, and SHA-256 bind the output to the reviewed inputs.
scenes.caption: The same rules calculate the metrics, preserve contradictions, and reproduce the same hash-bound packet.

scenes.title: Every unresolved question survives into review.
scenes.body: The output is a claim ledger and open-question queue—not a buy, sell, or approval recommendation.
scenes.proof: {claim_count} claims  /  {question_count} open questions  /  human judgment retained
scenes.caption: The output is a claim ledger, an open-question queue, and a human-review packet—not a recommendation.

scenes.title: Two released MCP gates verify the bundle.
scenes.body: Evidence Gate checks each artifact. Release Gate binds the verified artifacts into one release receipt.
scenes.proof: Evidence Gate 0.1.1  →  PASS     Release Gate 0.1.1  →  PASS
scenes.caption: Inspect every source, state, limitation, and receipt in the repository. Human judgment remains the boundary.

limitations: The demo is silent and caption-led; no external voice or media service is used.
Rendering is reproducible from public repository inputs, but encoder and font versions can change media bytes.
